parts.text: 用正常方式启动OV，不要在此对话后台任务启动，我要归档关闭对话了
后台任务里的 OpenViking 会随对话关掉。我先停掉它，再用原来的开机启动脚本拉起来。

tool_input.reason: 用正常启动脚本拉起 OpenViking，不要绑在本对话后台

tool_input.description: Read the normal OpenViking start script

parts.tool_output:
[{"type":"text","text":"@echo off
REM Auto-start OpenViking stack: Ollama (embedding) + OpenViking server
timeout /t 8 /nobreak >nul

REM 1) Ensure Ollama is serving on 11434
netstat -ano | findstr ":11434 " | findstr LISTENING >nul
if errorlevel 1 (
  start "" /min "%LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\Ollama\ollama.exe" serve
  timeout /t 6 /nobreak >nul
)

REM 2) Ensure OpenViking server is serving on 1933
netstat -ano | findstr ":1933 " | findstr LISTENING >nul
if errorlevel 1 (
  start "" /min "C:\Program Files\Python310\Scripts\openviking-server.exe" --config "%USERPROFILE%\.openviking\ov.conf"
)
"}]

tool_input.command: Get-CimInstance Win32_Process | Where-Object { $_.CommandLine -match 'openviking-server' } | ForEach-Object { Stop-Process -Id $_.ProcessId -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }; Start-Sleep -Seconds 2; $left = @(Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 1933 -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue); if ($left.Count) { 'port-still-listening' } else { 'port-free' }
tool_input.description: Stop session-bound OpenViking and free port 1933

parts.tool_output: [{"type":"text","text":"Error: subprocess-local: Windows Job runner exited with exit code 4294967295 before proving its managed range empty"}]

tool_input.command: $p = Get-CimInstance Win32_Process | Where-Object { $_.CommandLine -match 'openviking-server' }; if ($p) { $p | Select-Object ProcessId, Name | Format-Table } else { 'no-server-process' }; $c = Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 1933 -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if ($c) { $c | Select-Object OwningProcess, State | Format-Table } else { 'port-free' }

parts.text: 端口已经空出来了。接下来用启动脚本里的同一条命令，以独立最小化进程拉起服务。

tool_input.command: Start-Process -FilePath "C:\Program Files\Python310\Scripts\openviking-server.exe" -ArgumentList '--config',"$env:USERPROFILE\.openviking\ov.conf" -WindowStyle Minimized; $ok=$false; for ($i=0; $i -lt 20; $i++) { try { $r = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri http://127.0.0.1:1933/health -UseBasicParsing -TimeoutSec 3; Write-Output $r.Content; $ok=$true; break } catch { Start-Sleep -Seconds 2 } }; if (-not $ok) { 'health-timeout' }; Get-CimInstance Win32_Process | Where-Object { $_.Name -eq 'openviking-server.exe' -or ($_.Name -eq 'python.exe' -and $_.CommandLine -match 'openviking-server') } | Select-Object ProcessId, ParentProcessId, Name | Format-Table
tool_input.description: Start detached OpenViking and verify health

parts.text:
OpenViking 已经脱离本对话，按平时的方式独立运行了。

本对话里的后台任务已停掉。服务用和 `start-server.bat` 相同的命令重新拉起：`openviking-server.exe --config %USERPROFILE%\.openviking\ov.conf`，最小化独立进程，父进程是 Windows 会话进程，不再挂在这个对话上。

`/health` 返回 `ok`（0.5.3）。可以归档关闭这个对话。
